'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 25 August 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS13]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 Pennsylvania State Championship.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Site:''' Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 25 August 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
